children: Agricultural Bank of China said on September 6 that it has filed a plan on the Shanghai Stock Exchange to issue A-shares to specific investors, including China's Ministry of Finance, China Tobacco and related subsidiaries, with total proceeds capped at 160 billion yuan. After issuance costs, all net proceeds will be used to replenish core tier-1 capital, and the final fundraising size will be subject to regulatory approval, according to Jiemian News.

title: Agricultural Bank of China Plans Up to 160 Billion Yuan A-Share Placement to Boost Core Tier-1 Capital
